failure.message: The browser control interface could not complete the frozen interaction sequence reliably, so no viewport result was finalized.

incidents.description: The browser documentation exposed a network-idle load state, but the active browser interface rejected that state before the first result was recorded.
Raw page diagnostics were available, but the browser rejected Browser.getVersion; Runtime.evaluate could read the Chromium 151 user agent as a supported alternative.
After collapsed and open captures, the browser timed out locating details.ai-extension-accordion following reload, before the keyboard checks and evidence record could complete.

The local browser requested /service-worker.js although the repository contains no service-worker registration or file; the Python staging server returned 404. The frozen gate allows zero failed requests, so this observation must be resolved or explicitly classified before a new activation.
